overview_description.description: CADO Gifting develops a gifting platform to offer a range of enticing products for corporate gifting solutions, helping clients to follow the trend and gift the most unique products personalized with high touch service. CADO Gifting is a Dubai-based premium corporate and luxury gifting company that specializes in creating personalized gifting experiences for businesses, VIP clients, and special occasions across the GCC region. Founded in 2019, the company combines creativity, technology, logistics, and branding to deliver customized gifts, curated hampers, branded merchandise, and bespoke packaging solutions. CADO focuses on meaningful storytelling through gifting by collaborating with regional artisans, sustainable suppliers, and creative partners to produce culturally inspired and high-quality products. Its end-to-end services include product sourcing, custom branding, gift assembly, operational support, and global fulfillment, helping companies strengthen relationships with employees, clients, and partners.
